title: Chapter 526
text:
Far away in the battlefield where the Godoran fleet was fighting with the DarkStar fleet, Nakapu received the news that Black Star had stopped the assault team and was even slowly wiping them out. A look of surprise flashed across his face, and his brows furrowed.

"Black Star actually has such strength. This doesn't match the information we received!"

Intelligence was the basis for strategizing. With the wrong information, he had misjudged the enemy's strength and made a huge mistake in his strategy, causing the situation to slide in a disadvantageous direction. Nakapu could no longer maintain his calm expression. His expression turned serious.

"Black Star is protecting Blue Star. A small fleet is useless. With the strength he has displayed, even if we split up the assault team, we will still suffer heavy losses. My fleet is also being held back by Godora. If this drags on, Godora might send reinforcements …"

After thinking for a few seconds, Nakapu immediately came to a conclusion. This attack had failed!

"Everyone, take note. Do not get entangled. Retreat immediately!"

Seeing that things were not going well, Nakapu did not want to continue fighting and decisively ordered a retreat.

Dark-star's fleet stopped fighting and started to retreat. As Godora's fleet had used a space-disrupting device, Dark-star's fleet was unable to accelerate into hyperdrive. Thus, the fleet had been using targeted equipment to remove the effects of the interference. The further they were, the easier it was to remove the interference.

This meant that as long as they were a certain distance away, Dark-star's fleet would be able to hyperdrive away.

Nakapu was expressionless as he silently looked out the porthole. The colorful explosions on the space battlefield reflected on his face.

This was the first time Dark-star had suffered a loss. Thinking of this, Nakapu's eyes turned cold.

If he had known about Black Star's strength, he would not have split up his forces to reduce his losses. He would have used his entire army to break through Godora's defense line. However, there were no ifs in this world. Since the situation had already been decided, there was no point in regretting. He could only accept the result of his wrong decision. Nakapu sighed and calmed himself down.

The next time he made a comeback, he would definitely not let such a situation happen again.

…

The battle in the sky above Blue Star had reached its climax. The number of spaceships controlled by Black Star Mercenary was now equal to the number of enemy spaceships. In terms of scale and firepower, they were on par.

Boom!

One of the enemy ships lost the protection of its shield and was quickly blasted into pieces. It fell to the ground like a meteor, piercing through the clouds and disappearing from sight.

When the remaining ten Dark-star assault ships received Nakapu's order to retreat, they breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly fled into outer space. However, they were chased by the mercenaries and were fired at in a flurry.

This assault team originally thought that their mission would be very simple. All they had to do was to continuously fire their cannons from the sky. Who would have thought that they would encounter a head-on attack from the Black Star Mercenary? Furthermore, they were actually unable to defeat the enemy! Although they had the advantage in terms of numbers, the enemy's spaceship was too advanced. Not to mention dodging most of the attacks, even if they took the attacks head-on, they might not be able to break through the shield of the BlackLight Stealth. In terms of Supers, they were at an absolute disadvantage. As long as the enemy boarded the spaceship, there would be no hope left.

Their squad had suffered heavy losses, and they had no intention of staying here any longer. However, due to the orders they received, they did not dare to retreat. Nakapu's order to retreat was just too timely for them.

"We've finally chased the enemy away!"

Seeing the satellite image, the upper echelons of the Six Nations and the Sanctuary were overjoyed. The enemy had charged at them ferociously, and the trash Godora had abandoned them. Everyone had thought that they were doomed this time. Thankfully, Black Star had stepped forward and chased the enemy away. The territories of the various parties had only suffered light damage, and the situation was still good.

This was much better than what the people of Blue Star had expected.

At this time, Han Xiao, who was covered in smoke, finally returned to the BlackLight Stealth. Ginette turned around, but before she could show off, Han Xiao had grabbed her by the shoulder and lifted her up from the pilot's seat, throwing her onto Sylvia.

"Ouch!" Ginette and Sylvia crashed into each other and rolled to the side.

"Ouch, ouch, ouch!" Sylvia held her forehead and hissed in pain. She had been knocked on the head by Ginette's combat uniform.

Ginette rubbed her butt, and a hint of anger appeared on her beautiful face. "Oi, why did you throw me onto the ground! I'm a girl. Be gentler, you scum! "

Han Xiao could not be bothered with her. He put away his mechanical suit and sat in the pilot's seat. He rubbed his wrist and said, "The battle is not over yet. The enemy's command ship is being held back by Godora. With the speed of the BlackLight Stealth, we can reach the battlefield quickly. This is the best time to attack the enemy. Tell the others to stay in Blue Star and not move. I'll be back soon."

Herlous had just returned to the BlackLight Stealth and heard this the moment he entered. He turned around and jumped out of the hatch without hesitation.

What a joke. He did not want to sit in a spaceship piloted by Black Star!

"You want to interfere?" Ginette was shocked. "We've already stopped the enemy. There's no need for us to participate in the battle."

Han Xiao shook his head. "We've only destroyed a few assault spaceships. It's not even considered a loss to Dark-star. The enemy's commander is the key. Since they attacked us, it's best to bite them back."

His target was the command ship, not the escaping assault spaceships. As the old saying went, 'don't chase a cornered enemy'. It meant that one should not chase a poor enemy. Anyway, that was what Han Technician understood.

Therefore, if he was going to fight, he would fight the leader!

Because he had revealed his strength, Dark-star would update his intel. The enemy would definitely make arrangements based on this point next time. The enemy would not have any errors in their intel anymore unless he secretly killed another wave of players. Therefore, it was best to take advantage of this opportunity to expand the results of the battle. Destroying a command ship was also a requirement of many missions in [Godora's Ally].

Han Xiao piloted the BlackLight Stealth out of the atmosphere and locked onto the coordinates of the main battlefield. It was quite a distance away.

According to the feedback from Godora, it seemed like the enemy was retreating. However, the BlackLight Stealth was extremely mobile and could complete the acceleration before the hyperdrive in microseconds. It could arrive almost instantly and definitely make it in time.

The next moment, the BlackLight Stealth suddenly turned into a stream of light and disappeared into the dark universe.

…

The stream of light stopped not far from the battlefield, and further ahead was the area of space disruption. The chaotic battlefield was vividly displayed in front of their eyes. Ion cannons were densely packed, and all kinds of radiation weapons were shooting out colorful or invisible rays. Powerful homing missiles exploded into huge balls of flames, and plasma cannons melted through shields and spaceship armor.

"The battle is very intense …" Han Xiao glanced at the radar and raised his eyebrows. "Dark-star is indeed retreating. The largest spaceship in the middle is the command ship."

After locking onto the target, Han Xiao measured the distance. He had to go deep into the battlefield to allow the enemy's command ship to enter the range of his data transmitter. Furthermore, the artificial intelligence defense of the command ship was much stronger.

"Nagojin, I've settled things on my side. Where are you?"

Nagojin was in a spaceship and was being targeted by Dark-star's fleet. Faced with an overwhelming number of attacks, he was barely able to dodge and was unable to get close to the enemy's spaceship.

"Black Star? You've come to the battlefield? "

Han Xiao nodded. "Long story short, I can hack into the artificial intelligence of the enemy's spaceship. I'm preparing to make a move on the enemy's command ship. If you can get close, I can paralyze the command ship and the nearest few frigates, creating an instant opportunity for you to rush into the enemy's command ship."

Hearing this, Nagojin's face lit up. "Okay! Let's do that! "

At the same time, Barette's voice sounded in the communication channel. "You can try. My fleet will do its best to contain the enemy's firepower and allow Officer Nagojin to get close to the enemy's command ship."

Barette judged the situation and knew that he would not be able to stop Dark-star's fleet. Black Star had also arrived at this time. He had just learned about the situation on Blue Star's side and believed in Han Xiao's ability.

While he did not care much about Blue Star, Barette would not underestimate Black Star under the Dragon Emperor. At the very least, he would not doubt Han Xiao's ability.

A powerful mercenary who could make a name for himself in the Shattered Star Ring in just a few years was naturally not to be underestimated. He definitely had the strength to match his fame.

Ginette's expression changed. "We're going to rush into the battlefield? The risk is too high. There are stray bullets everywhere. Even I don't have the confidence to dodge all of them. This is just a small spaceship. One mistake, and we'll be in danger! "

"Humph, my piloting skills have been honed thousands of times. I've never made a mistake."

Han Xiao warmed up his wrists and suddenly sped up. "Sit tight."

The BlackLight Stealth suddenly sped up and entered the battlefield. It weaved through all sorts of attacks, rolling, stopping abruptly, diving, and circling. Its movements were endless. It was like an agile black bird, moving freely between the intersecting branches and easily passing through the gaps between all sorts of beams.

The view outside the porthole was spinning. Ginette hurriedly tied herself to the seat. At first, she was afraid that Han Xiao would make a mistake. After staring at it for a while, the veins on her forehead started to throb. It was as though her brain was spinning along with it. Her face gradually turned pale, and a nauseating feeling started to brew in her chest.

"Slow, slow down. I can't see clearly!" Ginette endured the discomfort and spoke. She did not expect Han Xiao's piloting skills to be far above hers. With this skill, he could be the ace pilot in any organization!

"Heh, you're not the one piloting the spaceship. What's the point of letting you see clearly?" Han Xiao said.

Ginette turned around to take a look, and her eyes widened. Han Xiao was using a few small mechanical hands controlled by his nerves to pilot the spaceship while he performed Virtual Intrusion. His hands were typing in data, multitasking.

Sylvia was so frightened that her lips turned white. "Te- Teacher, please don't drive dangerously!"

"Don't be noisy. I'm busy. Don't distract me."

The Dark-star fleet noticed the Blacklight Stealth entering the battlefield. Nakapu looked at the screen, and his expression changed.

"This is Black Star's spaceship. Why is he here?"

Suddenly, Nakapu recalled the situation reported by the assault team, and his eyes widened. "Not good. He's here for revenge. Everyone, listen up. Don't let that black spaceship get close to the command ship!"

Nakapu did not dare to ignore Black Star's Virtual Intrusion technology. If they entered the range of the other party's data transmission, the command ship would be hacked, and they would be in danger.

The Dark-star fleet changed their target, and the Blacklight Stealth was under even more pressure. Their formation also changed. The Bloody Gal command ship no longer stayed in the center but flew to the front of the formation, trying to increase the distance between them and Han Xiao.

Han Xiao frowned. "Looks like they've noticed me and don't want me to get close."

At this moment, Barette's fleet began to retaliate fiercely, suppressing the Dark-star fleet with all their might. At the same time, they tore at the tail of the Dark-star fleet to create gaps for the Blacklight Stealth.

Han Xiao's eyes lit up, and he immediately accelerated and rushed into the Dark-star fleet through the gaps. He was extremely agile, and with his piloting skills, he was like a fish in water even in the face of concentrated fire.

The Blacklight Stealth was a stealth spaceship created by the Radiant Federation, and its speed completely surpassed that of Godora and Dark-star. Han Xiao felt that it was a pity that the Blacklight Stealth was not equipped with the conventional weapons of the Radiant Federation. Otherwise, a single Psionic Particle Cannon would be able to penetrate the shields and hull of more than ten Dark-star battleships. If that was the case, there would be no need to go through so much trouble.

The power of the Psionic Particle Cannon was also different, depending on the technology used, energy source, and caliber. The Psionic Particle Cannon used by Godora and Dark-star was a common model in the universe.

At the same time, the Bloody Gal sounded an ear-piercing alarm.

"Warning! The spaceship has been infiltrated! Please take immediate action! I repeat, warning! Fly # ¥¥% … "

The AI of the spaceship suddenly turned into static, and Nakapu's expression changed drastically.

"Sh * t!"

Buzz!

All of a sudden, almost all the lights turned black, and the engine of the Bloody Gal suddenly stopped. Its speed plummeted, and it was overtaken by the Dark-star battleships behind it in an instant. The communication channel was also cut off.

Controlling an entire spaceship relied too heavily on the AI. As long as the AI was paralyzed, the spaceship would basically be paralyzed as well. If it had to be manually operated, the reaction speed would be much slower than the AI.

As long as a Virtual Mechanic was given space to perform, it would be a killing machine on the galactic battlefield!

Bang! Bang! Bang!

Suddenly, a loud sound could be heard from the command room, as though something had crashed into the spaceship. However, the AI was paralyzed, and no one knew what had happened.

However, just by guessing, the Dark-star members on the spaceship knew what had happened, and their faces were filled with nervousness and despair.

"It's — it's Nagojin …"
